records.name: St. John Cantius Parish
records.summary: A Catholic parish with Sunday Masses at 8, 10 and 11:30 am, some Masses said in Polish, and a Saturday evening vigil.
records.what_you_do: Come to Mass, and ask which Masses are in Polish. The page lists no community programs.

schedule.text: Sunday Masses at 8 am, 10 am and 11:30 am (in Polish). Saturday vigil at 4:30 pm. Weekday Mass Monday to Friday at 8 am in English, and Saturday at 8 am in Polish. Saturday confession 3:30 to 4:15 pm.

first_step.how: Come to a Sunday Mass, or call the rectory to ask about Polish-language Masses
first_step.basis: Mass is open to anyone and the rectory phone is listed

records.notes: The Archdiocese page says this parish merged with All Saints in 2013 (All Saints is closed on the list). The page marks some Masses as Polish without making clear which ones, so call to confirm. Holyday Masses at 9 am and 7 pm. The page says last updated 2 years ago, which is not a full date. Corrected by the orchestrator 2026-10-08: vigil is 4:30 pm; 40 Hours Devotion listed for October 18 to 20, 2026.

notes: one corrected record after the spot check
